services.desc: SEP 11 - 8 pm Keesler Marina Ready for a unique night out? Join us for a sunset bowfishing trip at the Marina piers! No problem-this is perfect for first-timers and seasoned bowfishers alike. Each trip is limited to just 4 people, so you’ll have plenty of space and personal attention. Space is limited, so make sure you register today.
